actual_scope: Can the production historical data-corner checker (research/copied-fixed/data_corners.cpp, exercised by research/copied-fixed/producer.py / make copied-fixed-verify) adopt the per-pivot cached update-column loop from research/data-corner-performance/ so the shipped copied-fixed path is faster while every pair receipt field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, R420 rref/geometry/mutants, frameopt.close, leech_minor, verify_factor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine for #1076, e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST-only edits) were skipped. The data-corner opt-in adapter already proved ~1.71× with ~169s→99s absolute wall time; production still used the nested column scan. This session wires that equivalent loop into the shipped source and certificate local pin, and demotes the pairwise-era live pin in research/data-corner-performance/.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: copied-fixed data-corner replay is part of make copied-fixed-verify / community verification. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production data_corners.cpp change with frozen baseline, identical complete receipts, corruption controls, certificate pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_DATA_CORNER_PRODUCTION via research/data-corner-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_DATA_CORNER_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 170.101→110.463 s, 1.54×); research/copied-fixed/certificate.json differs from base only in the data_corners.cpp local_sha256 pin; research/data-corner-performance demotes the pairwise-era working-source pin.
